WITH high_rate_fees AS (
  SELECT f.feesnode, f.feerate, f.rebrate, f.orderslink
  FROM fees f
  WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009
),
fees_with_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    hrf.feesnode,
    hrf.feerate,
    hrf.rebrate,
    hrf.orderslink,
    o.dealedge
  FROM high_rate_fees hrf
  INNER JOIN orders o ON hrf.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    fwo.orderslink,
    fwo.dealedge,
    AVG(fwo.feerate - fwo.rebrate) AS group_avg_net_fee,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM fees_with_orders fwo
  GROUP BY fwo.orderslink, fwo.dealedge
),
side_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.dealedge,
    AVG(gs.group_avg_net_fee) AS side_avg
  FROM group_stats gs
  GROUP BY gs.dealedge
),
filtered_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.orderslink,
    gs.dealedge,
    gs.group_avg_net_fee,
    gs.record_count,
    gs.group_avg_net_fee - sa.side_avg AS difference
  FROM group_stats gs
  JOIN side_averages sa ON gs.dealedge = sa.dealedge
  WHERE gs.group_avg_net_fee > sa.side_avg
)
SELECT 
  fg.orderslink,
  fg.dealedge,
  fg.group_avg_net_fee,
  fg.record_count,
  fg.difference
FROM filtered_groups fg
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN fg.difference IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  fg.difference DESC
LIMIT 10
